Geographies Served Programs Agaram Vidhai State Andhra Pradesh Puducherry Tamil Nadu Kerala States Andhra Pradesh Puducherry Tamil Nadu Kerala Agaram was established with the express goal of enabling the poor to benefit from a quality education. It has attempted to assist the most vulnerable children in Tamilnadu, who are primarily first-generation students attending rural government schools. Thousands of applications for financial aid for higher education are received by Agram annually. A strict grading system is used to determine whether students are worthy. Many institutions offer assistance to students during the application and admissions process. Additionally, they receive assistance in managing other financial and logistical needs, such as lodging, mess expenses, etc. Agram Mentoring Through the teaching of academic and nonacademic skills, the Agaram Mentorship program seeks to develop students on a comprehensive level. Through the mentorship program, Agaram gives each student individualized attention by matching them with a mentor—someone who is not a parent or teacher but rather someone who values education and the potential of each kid to succeed. Milestones & Track Record Agaram Foundation has supported over 1,950 students to graduate through its Vidhai program since 2010, and has expanded to provide mentorship, skills training, and entrepreneurship support programs. --> --> Leadership Team R S SURIYA Founder R S SURIYA Founder D JAISHREE Secretary SI KARTHI Trustee D JAISHREE Secretary TJ GNANAVEL Trustee Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AACTA6271B Registration Number 674/06 CSR Form 1 Not Available VO ID / Darpan ID TN/2017/0171626 --> 80G AACTA6271BF20214 12A AACTA6271BE20214 FCRA 075901415 About Headquarters Chennai, Tamil Nadu Since 2006 Demographies Served Youth --> Impact Since its inception, Agaram Foundation has supported over 6,000 students from marginalized families to access higher education and become first-generation graduates. Vision and Mission Agaram Foundation aims to bring about significant positive change in the socio-economic status of rural society by offering quality education to deserving youth and empowering them to become socially responsible adults.
